g.text: All the web UIs authenticate the users with Keycloak (OAuth2 /OIDC); scripts and flows use API keys.All the components send their logs, metrics and OpenTelemetrytraces to the monitoring stack.
OVHcloud Object Storage (S3,region GRA) - public HTTPSendpoint
Orange: external interfaces ofRS-Python, exposed in HTTPS bythe Envoy Gateway loadbalancer. Grey: externalsystems.
